<template>
  <div v-for="item in items" :key="item.id">{{ item.name }}</div>
</template>

<script>
export default {
  name: "TwoBlocks",
  inheritAttrs: false,
};
</script>

<script setup>
function checkBoth(a, b) {
  if (a && b) {
    return true;
  }
  return a || b;
}

function loopWhile(n) {
  let i = 0;
  while (i < n) {
    i++;
  }
  return i;
}
</script>
